title: chat: draft review card for the ask admin skill — spec part `data-draft-review` and a plugin-chatbot DraftReviewCard (links to Studio review; no publish in chat)
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ④ topic child (cross-repo half of a cloud card). Source: epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 M2 row 3 = cloud#5085 (plan v2 approved by the maintainer 2026-11-27 01:02Z 「同意，开工」): "a build turn that saved N drafts ends with a card listing N rows; publish from the card goes through the existing human publish path". cloud#5085's premise check (2026-11-27 20:54Z) found the chat renders no drafts; cloud's half is PR cloud#5172 (sends the data part). Business reason: an admin who builds in chat sees what was saved and where to review it, instead of hunting in Studio.
Owner: **repo:objectstack#3** (maintainer 2026-11-27 07:51Z: non-cloud tasks go to the objectstack seat). Filed by seat epic:#5027#1, which keeps cloud#5085 and the pin round.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p1 · size M · reach: admins with the cloud admin skill switched on (default off) · evidence: read (objectstack `origin/main` 8d34c440; cloud PR #5172).
Dedupe: searched `data-draft-review`, `DraftReviewCard`, `pending drafts` chat; no open card. Precedent: the question card (objectstack#37872 spec envelope, #37874 `QuestionCard`).

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：管理员在 ask 对话里搭建时，回合结束后在回答下面出一张卡，列出这一轮存的草稿和每个的判定（能发布 / 有几个问题），每行和每个包都带去工作室审阅的链接。
- 卡片上不发布、不丢弃，都去工作室现有的人工流程（席位裁定 Q1=A）。第一版只在实时对话里显示，刷新后不重建（Q2=A，之后另开 cloud 卡把部件存进消息）。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Where it renders (objectstack origin/main 8d34c440)
- The ask chat is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ChatPane.tsx` over `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` (`ChatbotEnhanced`, `mapMessages.ts`, `toolResultParsers.ts`).
- Only `data-chart` and `data-record-citations` are read today (`STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS`, `toolResultParsers.ts:325`). Nothing renders a `save_metadata_draft` / `list_drafts` result.

## What cloud sends (PR cloud#5172)
At the end of a streamed ask turn whose admin skill saved drafts, before `finish`, one UI-message-stream part:
```
{ type: 'data-draft-review', id: 'draft-review', data: {
    drafts: [{ type, name, package, label?, verdict: { publishable, refusals, advisories } | null,
               verdictWithheld?, verdictError?, verdictRead: 'turn-end' | 'save',
               review: { changes, item } }],   // save order, at most 50
    omitted?: number } }
```
`verdict` is the light door's own `list_drafts` verdict read at the turn's end as the person; `review` is the door's own review routes (`studioChangesReviewLink`, `studioItemReviewLink`).

## What to do
1. **Spec:** `packages/spec/src/ai/draft-review.zod.ts` with `DRAFT_REVIEW_PART_TYPE = 'data-draft-review'` and `DraftReviewListSchema` (closed objects, as above; field names may be refined, say so on this card before merge so cloud follows). Follow the spec change rules (changeset, generated baselines, api-surface, docs).
2. **plugin-chatbot:** a `DraftReviewCard` under the assistant message that carries the part. One row per draft: label or name, type, a verdict badge (will publish / N problems / verdict withheld), a "Review" link to `review.item`; per package a "Review and publish" link to `review.changes`; `omitted` shown as "+N more". No publish and no discard button (seat ruling Q1 = A). Strings in every ui locale pack.
3. **Live only in v1** (seat ruling Q2 = A): do not rebuild the card from stored `save_metadata_draft` results (save-time verdicts can be wrong). Do not add the part to `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS` until a cloud card stores it on the assistant message.

## Acceptance
- A stream fixture with the part renders N rows with the right badges and links; a malformed part renders nothing (no crash); a turn without the part is unchanged.
- Accessible names on the links; no overflow in the eleven locales.
- Hand-off: when merged, Notify seat epic:#5027#1 (mailbox objectstack#37634) with the sha; cloud then switches to the spec constant (closes cloud#5085) after a pin round.

Clause-②: yes
Suggested-grade: p1
